subject: ClientCo SIG intake: onboarding, temporal access & evidence owners
messages:
From: Priya Shah <priya@clientco.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: security@clientco.com
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG intake & short onboarding call?

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo last week — we have a SIG/Caiq intake to kick off for our procurement team. Would you be available for a 30-minute intake today or tomorrow to go over evidence owners, what we can expect for temporary access requests (logs, recordings), and the attachment inventory? Our team prefers afternoons PST.

I attached our blank SIG template for reference. High-level asks:
- Timeline for evidence delivery (logs, config snapshots)
- Process for read-only, time-bound access to demo environments
- Typical owners Redwood assigns for audit artifacts

Thanks,
Priya
Procurement Manager | ClientCo
Attachment: ClientCo_SIG_Template_v1.xlsx (xlsx)

From: soojin_lee@redwood.com
To: Priya Shah <priya@clientco.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG intake & short onboarding call?

Hi Priya —

Thanks for sending the template. We can do today at 3:30pm PST or tomorrow at 2:00pm PST. I put 3:30pm on the calendar tentatively and will adjust if you prefer the earlier slot.

Quick answers up front so the call is focused:
- Evidence timeline: for CAIQ items that map to configuration and policy docs we can deliver within 5 business days; for logs and sampling (audit logs, auth events) we typically need a scoped request and can produce samples within 7–10 business days depending on retention and redaction needs.
- Temporal access: we support time-bound, read-only access via our evidence portal; we will need an explicit scope and an RBAC list. By default, access is 7 days, extendable with approvals.
- Owners: I will lead the engagement (SIG owner). Marissa will own evidence collection for infra controls; Aditya will cover runtime/keys and logging artifacts.

Agenda for the 30m: introductions, confirm high-priority CAIQ sections, agree evidence owners and temporal access process, and confirm next steps + deliverables.

Link to our access playbook: https://redwood.app/drive/clientco/SIG-intake-20260817 (I also attached a short PDF extract).

Talk soon —
Soojin Lee
Security & Compliance Lead | Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood-access-playbook.pdf

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 11:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG intake & short onboarding call? (internal owners)

Short internal note —

Thanks for the heads up. I'll prep the following for the call:
- Mapping of CAIQ items to Redwood docs (docs + config snippets)
- A sample set of access logs (anonymized) and a short note on retention windows
- A checklist for temporal access requests (what we need from ClientCo: user list, justification, scope)

Aditya — can you confirm whether vault access snapshots and KMS key rotation records are available for sampling, or do we need to request a separate extraction?

Kimberly — could you be on the call to capture decisions for the SLA/retention questions?

Marissa
Manager, Compliance Operations

From: aditya_rao@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 12:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG intake & short onboarding call? (vault & keys)

Marissa —

We can produce KMS rotation logs and a snapshot of key metadata. For actual key material we cannot share (obvious), but rotation tables and policy statements are available. I'll pull a 30-day rotation history and a sample of access events (RBAC audit) — those will need redaction of user IDs that are internal-only. Allow 5 business days to prepare the extracts once scope is signed off on the call.

Also: if ClientCo needs temporal access into a demo cluster, we prefer to issue scoped IAM roles with CloudWatch streaming to our evidence portal for the window. That avoids sharing credentials.

—Aditya

From: Priya Shah <priya@clientco.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: security@clientco.com
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG intake & short onboarding call? — confirmed

Hi Soojin,

3:30pm PST today works — calendar accepted. Thanks for the pre-read. On the call we'll prioritize the CAIQ sections around authentication, logging, and cryptography.

Two small asks before the meeting:
1) Could you populate column B of our attached SIG template with the Redwood doc links you referenced? That will help our reviewers triage during procurement.
2) Please confirm whether the standard temporal access window can be 14 days (our security policy prefers longer windows for product testing) or whether 7 days is the default. If 14 requires additional approvals, tell us what that path looks like.

See you at 3:30.

Best,
Priya
Procurement Manager | ClientCo
Attachment: ClientCo_SIG_Template_v1.xlsx (updated)
